title: SEO Blog Post That Outranks
description: Tear down the top Google results for a target keyword, design an outline that beats them, and write a 1,500+ word draft ready for the client's blog.

nodes.title: Tear down the top 5–7 Google results
nodes.detail: Search Google for the target keyword and open the top 5–7 organic results. For each page record: title pattern, estimated word count, heading count and structure, where the keyword appears (title / first paragraph / headings), and the subtopics covered. Then identify the content gaps — things searchers want that none of the top pages cover well.
nodes.acceptance: 5+ pages analyzed structurally and 2+ content gaps identified.

subtasks.title: Collect and dissect top results
subtasks.purpose: Title, length, headings, keyword placement per page

subtasks.title: List shared subtopics
subtasks.purpose: What every ranking page must cover

nodes.title: Design the winning outline
nodes.detail: Build an outline that covers every shared subtopic AND fills the gaps: 5 title options (keyword-forward with a click driver), 6–8 headings with each section's core message and target word count, a keyword and related-term placement plan, and image slots with text descriptions of what each image should show.
nodes.acceptance: 5 title options and 6+ planned sections completed.

outputScope.name: outline
outputScope.description: Per-section heading, core message, target words

nodes.title: Write and save the 1,500+ word draft
nodes.detail: Write the full draft in markdown following the outline: 1,500+ words, keyword naturally in the first paragraph, first-hand practitioner tone, image slots marked as [Image: description] text directions. End the file with 5 title options and a meta description draft (under 160 characters).
nodes.acceptance: 1,500+ words, 6+ headings, image directions, titles, and meta description saved.

subtasks.title: Write each section to plan
subtasks.purpose: Follow the outline's messages and lengths

subtasks.title: Place keywords and related terms
subtasks.purpose: Apply the placement plan without over-optimizing

outputScope.name: keyword_occurrences
outputScope.description: Times the target keyword appears in the body

nodes.title: Verify draft quality
nodes.detail: Check that word_count is 1,500+, sections_written has 6+ headings, keyword_occurrences sits in the 5–15 range (no stuffing, no absence), and there are 3+ image slots.
